sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), nets AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), closings AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM spine), totals AS (SELECT m,SUM(MAX(closing,0)) total_clipped_balance,SUM(closing) total_raw_balance,SUM(MAX(net,0)) total_clipped_net FROM closings GROUP BY m), shifted AS (SELECT m,LAG(total_clipped_balance) OVER(ORDER BY m) previous_total_balance FROM totals) SELECT m month,previous_total_balance FROM shifted WHERE m>(SELECT MIN(m) FROM months) ORDER BY m
